plugin.description: Switches the default audio output between devices - speakers, headphones, HDMI - from a key.
plugin.requirements: PulseAudio or PipeWire with the PulseAudio interface.

SetOutput.description: Makes one device the default audio output. The key shows whether that device is the current output. Use one key per device when several outputs should be reachable directly.

device.description: The output device, by its PulseAudio node name.

port.description: Port of that device, for cards that have several (headphone jack vs line out). Empty just switches the device.

ToggleOutput.description: Switches back and forth between two output devices with one key - the usual speakers/headphones toggle. The key shows which of the two is active.

device_a.description: First output device, by its PulseAudio node name. Shown as speakers on the key.

device_a_port.description: Port of the first device, if it has several.

device_b.description: Second output device, by its PulseAudio node name. Shown as headphones on the key.

device_b_port.description: Port of the second device, if it has several.
